sql: SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE auditor != '' GROUP BY auditor_family
SELECT major_equity_changes, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE major_equity_changes IN ('Yes', 'No') GROUP BY major_equity_changes

SELECT CASE WHEN remuneration_policy LIKE '%Mixed%' THEN 'Mixed' WHEN remuneration_policy != '' THEN 'Other' END AS pay_policy, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE remuneration_policy != '' GROUP BY pay_policy

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, AVG(revenue) AS avg_revenue FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' AND revenue > 0 GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, AVG(net_profit_or_loss) AS avg_profit FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, AVG(total_assets) AS avg_assets FROM finance WHERE auditor != '' AND total_assets IS NOT NULL GROUP BY auditor_family
SELECT business_segments_num, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE business_segments_num BETWEEN 1 AND 8 GROUP BY business_segments_num

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, MAX(revenue) AS max_revenue FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' AND revenue > 0 GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN net_profit_or_loss > 0 THEN 'profitable' WHEN net_profit_or_loss < 0 THEN 'loss_making' END AS profit_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE net_profit_or_loss IS NOT NULL AND net_profit_or_loss != 0 GROUP BY profit_status

SELECT CASE WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Finance%' THEN 'Finance' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Healthcare%' THEN 'Healthcare' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Technology%' THEN 'Technology' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Retail%' THEN 'Retail' WHEN principal_activities LIKE '%Mining%' THEN 'Mining' WHEN principal_activities != '' THEN 'Other' END AS activity_family, AVG(business_segments_num) AS avg_segments FROM finance WHERE principal_activities != '' AND business_segments_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY activity_family

SELECT CASE WHEN dividend_per_share > 0 THEN 'pays_dividend' WHEN dividend_per_share = 0 THEN 'no_dividend' END AS dividend_status, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE dividend_per_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dividend_status

SELECT CASE WHEN auditor LIKE '%Ernst & Young%' OR auditor LIKE 'EY%' THEN 'EY' WHEN auditor LIKE '%KPMG%' THEN 'KPMG' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Pricewaterhouse%' OR auditor LIKE '%PwC%' THEN 'PwC' WHEN auditor LIKE '%Deloitte%' THEN 'Deloitte' WHEN auditor != '' THEN 'Other' END AS auditor_family, AVG(earnings_per_share) AS avg_eps FROM finance WHERE auditor != '' AND earnings_per_share IS NOT NULL GROUP BY auditor_family

SELECT CASE WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NASDAQ%' THEN 'NASDAQ' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%NYSE%' THEN 'NYSE' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%ASX%' THEN 'ASX' WHEN exchange_code LIKE '%LSE%' OR exchange_code LIKE '%AIM%' THEN 'London' WHEN exchange_code != '' THEN 'Other' END AS exchange_family, SUM(cash_reserves) AS total_cash FROM finance WHERE exchange_code != '' AND cash_reserves IS NOT NULL GROUP BY exchange_family

SELECT CASE WHEN business_segments_num = 1 THEN 'single_segment' WHEN business_segments_num BETWEEN 2 AND 3 THEN 'two_or_three' WHEN business_segments_num >= 4 THEN 'four_or_more' END AS segment_band, COUNT(*) AS company_count FROM finance WHERE business_segments_num IS NOT NULL GROUP BY segment_band

SELECT major_equity_changes, AVG(the_highest_ownership_stake) AS avg_top_stake FROM finance WHERE major_equity_changes IN ('Yes', 'No') AND the_highest_ownership_stake IS NOT NULL GROUP BY major_equity_changes
